CREATE TABLE dbo.Employee
(
    EmployeeID INT NOT NULL,
    FirstName VARCHAR(50),
    LastName VARCHAR(50),
    Gender VARCHAR(10),
    Email VARCHAR(100),
    PhoneNumber VARCHAR(15),
    Department VARCHAR(50),
    Designation VARCHAR(50),
    Salary DECIMAL(10,2),
    JoiningDate DATE
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
);
